suspicious_activity.narrative: Tracy Lewis (CUST_0053), a medium-risk customer, exhibited potential structuring behavior. Despite her income, account balances and transaction volumes are unusually high. From July 25-31, 2025, seven consecutive cash deposits just below the $10,000 reporting threshold were made at various branches, totaling $67,569.06. This pattern suggests an attempt to evade BSA/AML reporting requirements.
key_indicators: High transaction volume compared to income
suspicious_activity.ai_reasoning: Customer's profile shows medium risk rating. Account balances and average monthly transactions are significantly higher than the customer's annual income. The last 7 transactions are cash deposits just below $10,000, indicating potential structuring to avoid reporting thresholds.

regulatory_compliance.narrative_reasoning: The narrative succinctly identifies the customer, describes the suspicious activity (structuring), provides specific transaction details, and explains why the activity is suspicious (potential evasion of reporting requirements).
